title: HeidelbergCement
content: HeidelbergCement AG rebranded as Heidelberg Materials in September 2022. ## HeidelbergCement Market Cap. The company’s market capitalization stands at approximately 35.6 billion EUR as of 2025. Heidelberg Materials has a presence in over 50 countries worldwide. Heidelberg Materials, formerly known as HeidelbergCement AG, stands as one of the world’s largest building materials companies. Founded in 1874 in Heidelberg, Germany, the company has evolved from a single cement plant to a global powerhouse in construction materials. Its strategic acquisitions have positioned it as the number one producer of aggregates, second-largest in cement, and third-largest in ready-mixed concrete globally. HeidelbergCement rebranded as Heidelberg Materials in September 2022, reflecting the company’s diverse building materials portfolio beyond cement manufacturing. title: Lehigh Hanson to become Heidelberg Materials
content: ## Recent Posts & and Updates. ### Lehigh Hanson to become Heidelberg Materials. Lehigh Hanson, Inc. is pleased to announce the transformation of its global parent company, HeidelbergCement, to Heidelberg Materials, a new brand with a global reach and a focus on sustainability, digitalization and leadership in the building materials industry. As the North American subsidiary of HeidelbergCement, Lehigh Hanson will begin the process to become Heidelberg Materials in early 2023. “This is a major step change for our company, both globally and here in North America,” said Chris Ward, President and CEO of Lehigh Hanson and Member of the Managing Board of Heidelberg Materials. The change to Heidelberg Materials will launch in North America beginning in the first quarter of 2023, and ultimately will be rolled out in the different geographies and operational areas during the remainder of the year and beyond.

title: Company Leadership Team - Heidelberg Materials
content: Chris Ward is President and CEO of Heidelberg Materials North America. He has been with the company since 1996 and most recently served as President of the company’s Canada Region. Ward has also held management positions in Georgia, North Carolina and Texas. He has been with the company since 2012 and has held a variety of senior management roles. Previously, he served as Vice President of Finance for the company’s South Region. Oliver Patsch is President of Heidelberg Materials North America's Northwest Region. Matteo Rozzanigo is President of Heidelberg Materials North America's Northeast Region. Prior to his current role, he served as Senior Vice President and General Manager Materials for the company’s Northeast Region. He has been with the company since 2001 and has held a number of management positions in North America, including Senior Vice President & General Manager of Northeast Materials, Vice President & General Manager of the New York Materials business and a variety of operations management and continuous improvement roles.
